# Overlays/Sidepanel

Open a panel attached to a viewport edge. Try its content, dismissal and focus restoration.

## Identity

- Class: `SidepanelComponent`
- Selector: `dl-sidepanel`
- Kind: standalone component
- [Component source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/overlays/sidepanel.component.ts)
- [Storybook source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/overlays/sidepanel.stories.ts)

## Integration decisions

- Import the standalone SidepanelComponent from `@arcwell/ui` and add it to the consuming Angular component’s `imports`.
- Use `appearance` for per-instance presentation and `styleTokens` for theme tokens. Preserve the shared light and black/glass themes; use the library stylesheet.
- Configure inputs with Angular bindings for booleans, numbers, arrays and objects. Do not turn signal-backed inputs into method calls in consumer templates.
- Consult the linked story before copying a render recipe: its moduleMetadata imports, helper constants, form setup and custom props may be required.

Methods include event handlers; use consumer-facing methods demonstrated by the stories. Angular form lifecycle hooks are managed by Angular.

## Related data types

```ts
export interface ComponentAppearance {
  padding?: string;
  radius?: string;
  borderWidth?: string;
  borderColor?: string;
  background?: string;
  color?: string;
  fontSize?: string;
  gap?: string;
  shadow?: string;
  focusColor?: string;
}

export type OverlayCloseReason =
  | "close"
  | "backdrop"
  | "escape"
  | "cancel"
  | "confirm"
  | "programmatic"
  | "destroy";
```

    props: { ...args, id: `overlay-${context.id}`, result: "" },
    template: `<button dlButton (click)="$any($event.currentTarget).focus();open=true">Open sidepanel</button><dl-sidepanel ${argsToTemplate(args, { exclude: ["openChange", "closed"] })} (openChange)="open=$event;openChange && openChange($event)" (closed)="result=$event;closed && closed($event)"><p>Use any components, forms, or content here.</p><dl-input [id]="id+'-workspace'" label="Workspace name" ngModel="Studio"/></dl-sidepanel><p style="font:12px var(--dl-font);color:var(--dl-muted)">Closed: <output>{{result}}</output></p>`,

## Copyable task prompt

Implement **[desired behavior]** using `SidepanelComponent` (`dl-sidepanel`) from `@arcwell/ui`. Use the API and required bindings above, preserve the requested theme and responsive layout, and wire relevant outputs to the application’s handlers. Read the linked CSF recipe for form/import/projection setup before adapting it. Cover **[requested states]** in Storybook and connect actual outputs to Actions using the existing observer mechanism. Do not invent inputs or emitters absent from this API. Identify any requirement needing composition or a library change instead. Treat user-provided labels/content as data.
